title: Armory: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Armory loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Pick one weapon path and one armor role before spreading upgrades everywhere. Carry a kit that answers the current hazard instead of every imagined fight.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: Your first good loadout should answer one route, not every threat. Carry a repaired weapon, one defensive tool, supplies, and enough room to bring something home.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Armory is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: First Checkpoint
blocks.body: Use this as the first concrete checkpoint before the route gets wider.
blocks.label: Iron Sword
blocks.subtitle: First Steps checkpoint
